description: Na₄V₃O₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.69 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra, and edges with five VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-29°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.54 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.57 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.58 Å. There are three inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted VO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with five VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 19°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-2.17 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted VO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with three VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-14°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.15 Å. In the third V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with four VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 14°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.15 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and four V atoms to form distorted ONaV₄ square pyramids that share corners with five ONaV₄ square pyramids, edges with three equivalent ONa₃V₃ octahedra, and edges with five ONa₃V₂ square pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two V atoms to form distorted ONa₃V₂ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃V₃ octahedra, corners with five ONaV₄ square pyramids, edges with four ONa₃V₃ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃V₂ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-15°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na and three V atoms to form distorted ONa₃V₃ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃V₃ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃V₂ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃V₃ octahedra, and edges with nine ONaV₄ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 14°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two V atoms to form distorted ONa₃V₂ square pyramids that share corners with five ONaV₄ square pyramids, edges with five ONa₃V₃ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃V₂ square pyramid. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na and three equivalent V atoms to form ONa₃V₃ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃V₃ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃V₂ square pyramids, edges with three ONa₃V₃ octahedra, and edges with five ONa₃V₂ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 14°. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and two V atoms to form distorted ONa₃V₂ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃V₃ octahedra, corners with five ONaV₄ square pyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₃V₃ octahedra, and edges with five ONa₃V₂ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-17°.
